metadata.description: Plugins e skills do Flavio Magacho para o Claude Code

plugins.name: statusbar
plugins.description: Statusline de duas linhas: diretório, branch, modelo, modo, plano, contexto, franquias de uso, org e identidade git. Depois de instalar, rode /statusbar:setup.

plugins.name: vibe
plugins.description: Refine demands into build-ready specs (spec), design or refactor code into clean low-coupling modules (modular), and audit a codebase 360° into a Bemobi HTML deck (360).

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Audita (read-only) e instala harness em repositórios novos e legados: hooks, permissões, catraca de violações e CLAUDE.md hierárquico.

plugins.name: magents
plugins.description: Compare the real cost-to-your-door of a product across AliExpress, Mercado Livre, Shopee and Amazon — including Brazilian import tax (Remessa Conforme) and shipping — by driving the live sites with a stealth browser that reuses the user's own logged-in session. Runs locally.
